description: Implementation of NuPlayer class for media playback in Android, managing data sources, decoders, rendering, and playback control.

classes.name: NuPlayer
classes.description: Main class managing media playback, including data source setup, decoder management, rendering, and control flow.

methods.name: setUID
methods.description: Sets the user ID associated with the playback session.

methods.name: setDriver
methods.description: Associates a NuPlayerDriver with this player instance.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the data source from a stream source object.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the data source from a URL with optional headers.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the data source from a file descriptor, offset, and length.

methods.name: setVideoSurfaceTexture
methods.description: Sets the surface texture for video output.

methods.name: setAudioSink
methods.description: Sets the audio sink for audio output.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts media playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses media playback.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes media playback.

methods.name: resetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously resets the player.

methods.name: seekToAsync
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position asynchronously.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages for playback control and decoder events.

methods.name: finishFlushIfPossible
methods.description: Completes flushing of decoders if conditions are met.

methods.name: finishReset
methods.description: Finalizes the reset process, clearing resources.

methods.name: postScanSources
methods.description: Posts a message to scan for media sources.

methods.name: instantiateDecoder
methods.description: Creates and configures a decoder for audio or video.

methods.name: feedDecoderInputData
methods.description: Feeds input data to the decoder from the source.

methods.name: renderBuffer
methods.description: Renders a buffer through the renderer.

methods.name: notifyListener
methods.description: Notifies the driver of playback events.

methods.name: flushDecoder
methods.description: Flushes the specified decoder, optionally shutting it down.
